meta.description: Rented GPU price tiers for normalisation. Prices are per GPU-hour on demand, excluding GST. Each row says where it is hosted, for the data-residency rule. Older or smaller GPUs can be added as rows; the calculator does not assume top-end hardware.

rows.label: IndiaAI portal, average subsidised rate
rows.note: PIB headline average for eligible users. Eligibility applies; sources disagree (about 65 to 100 rupees). Verify on the portal.

rows.label: IndiaAI portal, H100 SXM on demand, L1 bid
rows.note: Read from the portal calculator by a secondary source on 1 Nov 2026; excludes GST and the subsidy (capped at 40%).

rows.label: Indian commercial cloud, H100 SXM list price
rows.note: Shakti Cloud and Yotta list Rs 356; E2E Rs 379.05 (secondary reading, Oct to Nov 2026). The brief's older figure was about Rs 217.

rows.label: Hyperscaler, H100 capacity block, Mumbai region
rows.note: AWS Capacity Block Mumbai per H100-hour as reported by a secondary source. The brief cited 2.50 to 4.00 USD for hyperscalers generally.

rows.label: Your own quote (edit the price below)
rows.note: Use for previous-generation GPUs or a negotiated rate.
